title: Pretty in Pink
about: A girl from the wrong side of town falls for a rich kid, while her best mate Duckie pines for her.
cue: Serve the snacks when Duckie dances on the record shop counter.
faces: DOORS OPEN, THE FLOOR IS YOURS
“I made my own dress and I made dinner too. Pull up a chair, Duckie, before you start dancing on the table.”
Crisp popcorn in pink white chocolate with freeze dried raspberry.
Sushi rolls of salmon, cucumber and spicy mayo, with soy, wasabi and pickled ginger.
Slow braised beef with onion, carrot, garlic, potatoes and rich stock.
Vanilla and strawberry sponge joined with pink and white buttercream.
Cranberry, pineapple and lemonade punch with frozen raspberries.

Two drink minimum at the stage tables. Cover charge after nine. No discussing Andie's job at the record store at the tables. Card No. 1986. Showtime: Serve the snacks when Duckie dances on the record shop counter.

    StartersDuckie's dance-off popcornCrisp popcorn in pink white chocolate with freeze dried raspberry.How to make it50g popcorn kernels1 tbsp neutral oil80g white chocolate10g freeze-dried raspberriesPop the kernels in the oil in a covered pot, shaking regularly.Melt the white chocolate gently.Crush the raspberries to a powder and stir into the chocolate to tint it pink.Toss through the popcorn and spread on a lined tray.Leave to set.Steff's party salmon makiSushi rolls of salmon, cucumber and spicy mayo, with soy, wasabi and pickled gingerHow to make it400g sushi rice80ml rice vinegar1 tbsp caster sugar4 nori sheets300g sashimi-grade salmon1 Lebanese cucumber3 tbsp Japanese mayonnaise1 tsp sriracha60ml soy sauce1 tube wasabi1 jar pickled gingerRinse the rice until the water runs clear, then cook with 480ml water, covered, on low for 12 minutes. Rest 10 minutes.Stir the vinegar with the sugar and 1 tsp salt until dissolved, fold through the rice and cool.Cut the salmon and cucumber into long strips. Mix the mayonnaise with the sriracha.Spread a quarter of the rice over each nori sheet, leaving a strip bare at the far edge. Lay salmon, cucumber and a line of spicy mayo along the middle and roll up tight with a mat.Slice each roll into 8 with a wet knife. Serve with soy, wasabi and ginger.MainsAndie's dad's pot roastSlow braised beef with onion, carrot, garlic, potatoes and rich stock.How to make it900g beef chuck roast1 tsp salt1/2 tsp black pepper1 tbsp neutral oil2 brown onions, quartered3 carrots, chopped4 garlic cloves500ml beef stock600g potatoes, peeled and chunkedHeat the oven to 160°C. Season the beef and brown all sides in the neutral oil in a heavy casserole.Add the onions, carrots, garlic and stock, then cover and braise.Add the potatoes, cover and cook until the beef and potatoes are tender.Rest the beef, slice or pull apart and serve with the vegetables and stock.Blane's turkey and avocado clubBlane's world across townHow to make itAs written, serves 4Toasted triple-decker of roast turkey, crisp bacon, avocado, lettuce, tomato and lemon mayo, pinned and cut into triangles with shoestring fries.Bake 800g frozen shoestring fries at 220°C for 20 minutes and salt.Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp.Mix 4 tbsp mayo with lemon zest.Toast 12 slices white bread.Build each club as toast, mayo, 100g sliced turkey and lettuce, toast, mayo, 2 rashers bacon, sliced avocado and tomato, toast.Pin with 4 toothpicks and cut into triangles.SweetsTwo-dress prom cakeVanilla and strawberry sponge joined with pink and white buttercream.How to make it100g strawberries, chopped200g butter, soft120g caster sugar2 eggs140g self-raising flour1/2 tsp vanilla extract160g icing sugar1 tsp milk1 drop pink food colouringHeat the oven to 180°C and line two 12cm round tins. Cook the strawberries over low heat until reduced to a thick puree and cool.Beat part of the butter with the caster sugar until pale, beat in the eggs and fold in the flour.Divide the batter. Stir vanilla into one half and the strawberry puree into the other.Bake side by side until a skewer comes out clean, then cool.Beat the remaining butter with the icing sugar and milk, and tint half pink.Cut both cakes in half and join one vanilla and one strawberry half with buttercream. Cover half pink and half white and pipe a seam. Cut into four portions.DrinksProm punchCranberry, pineapple and lemonade punch with frozen raspberries.How to make it500ml cranberry juice500ml pineapple juice750ml lemonade2 oranges, sliced150g frozen raspberries3 cups iceMix the cranberry juice, pineapple juice and lemonade in a big glass bowl.Add the orange slices and raspberries so they float on top.Ladle into glasses over ice.
